name: Carnitas Las Michoacánas
notes: 4 photos, all legible menus/menu boards for this restaurant (a laminated handheld menu and two wall boards, one of which also lists a sister San Diego location). Item names and dishes are consistent across photos but the same item sometimes carries a different price on different boards (e.g. Menudo, Carnitas por Libra) likely reflecting price updates over time or the two locations; used the clearest/most common price per item. Drinks (cerveza, clamato, sodas, horchata, jamaica) were omitted as beverages.
